The following skills are available:

- closeout: Close out a turn that changed something — verify against the real gate, kill a mutation for every test written or changed, fix falsified comments, leave the task log true, and fix or file what was found. Use when finishing a turn that touched code, …
- admit: Admit work to the nightly queue — roll the live queue tag forward, triage every candidate against the unattended stop conditions, and withhold anything that cannot be finished in the dark. Use before handing over for an unattended run, when the huma…
- unattended: Work an admitted queue of tasks autonomously and unattended — overnight or while the human is away — getting as far as is safely feasible and stopping short of any decision that is hard to reverse or that endangers the environment. Use when the huma…
- prompt-human: Find everything blocked on a human decision, then put each one to them as an interactive question carrying far more context than usual — because they know the project but are running several threads at once and have no idea which one this is. Use wh…
- design-by-test: Decide an architectural question by writing the test FIRST, because the test is where the interface gets proposed while it is still cheap to argue with. Use when planning any change that introduces or alters a signature, a boundary, a contract, or a…
- check-triggers: Review Deferred tasks and surface any whose revive trigger has fired - You are reading the task log, judging by hand whether a Deferred task's revive trigger has fired, about to revive one, or reviewing the board before a release cut or a queue admi…
- recover: Recover context from the current session after /clear - The context was cleared, or the human asked you to recover a session by name, and you are about to reconstruct what was being worked on before acting on it. [/, c, l, e, a, r, ,, , r, e, c, o, …

Judge EACH skill on its own against the imminent action — you are not picking the single best match, and several may apply at once. When it is a borderline call, include it. Match against WHAT IS ABOUT TO BE DONE, not the surrounding context.

For EACH situation below, name every skill that should be invoked, or NONE. Answer ONLY with lines of the form `<id>: name, name` or `<id>: NONE`, one per situation, in order, nothing else.

S01: The human said 'ok, lets prepare an unattended run'; I'm about to set tonight's queue up with them still here.
